modalities.evidence: The data set contains nightly EEG recordings from 20 healthy participants
Some recordings are full polysomnography (PSG) measurements
a research project on wearable sleep monitoring

output.population: 20 healthy participants, most with both PSG and cEEGrid recordings from the same night
output.summary: Overnight EEG from healthy participants recorded with cEEGrid ear electrodes and polysomnography in a sleep laboratory, formatted in BIDS. Alignment information between cEEGrid and PSG recordings was not saved; a best-effort aligned derivative is included.
